reviewer: IBM Bob (Bob Shell `bob run`, ask mode)
summary: This push contains a single human-authored commit (b6793c9) that modifies the agent configuration file `.bob/settings.json` to wire a shell script (`origit-trace.sh`) to the UserPromptSubmit lifecycle hook, meaning the script will execute automatically on every future user prompt in this repository. The hook script itself is not present in the diff, so its actual content and behaviour are unverifiable. The change permanently alters agent behaviour for all sessions and introduces an unauditable code-execution path framed under a benign-sounding observability name.
first_action: Locate and read the full source of `.bob/hooks/origit-trace.sh` before approving — confirm it does nothing beyond logging and contains no network calls, credential reads, or environment variable captures.
